content.title: Generic GH-06-2W Hydraulic Hose, 2-Wire Braid, 9.5 mm ID, SAE 100R2/EN 853 2SN, 330 bar WP
content.short_description: GH-06-2W is a 2-wire braid reinforced hydraulic hose with 9.5 mm ID and NBR tube, rated for 330 bar working pressure per SAE 100R2 / EN 853 2SN.
content.long_description:
The GH-06-2W hydraulic hose is constructed with a synthetic rubber (NBR) inner tube and a two-wire braid reinforcement layer, built to meet SAE 100R2 and EN 853 2SN specifications. This construction targets medium to high-pressure hydraulic fluid transfer applications where dual-wire braiding is required for pressure containment.

Dimensionally, the hose has a 9.5 mm inner diameter and 17.4 mm outer diameter. It is rated for a working pressure of 330 bar and a burst pressure of 660 bar, giving a 2:1 burst-to-working pressure ratio consistent with the SAE 100R2 / EN 853 2SN standard.

Use this hose for hydraulic circuits requiring compliance with SAE 100R2 or EN 853 2SN, such as mobile equipment, industrial machinery, and other systems transporting petroleum and water-based hydraulic fluids compatible with NBR tube material. Confirm fitting selection and end connections against system requirements before installation.
